fishing: WHEN: Sun Nov 15 mild fall, after recent fronts; bites steady on moving water. PASSES-BEACH: redfish, whiting, pompano, sheepshead, flounder, Spanish near Englewood Beach / Manasota / Stump Pass on live shrimp, paddletails, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: redfish under mangroves and oysters, snook, trout, flounder, sheepshead on docks/flats; shrimp/spoons/pinfish working. NEARSHORE: Spanish, ladyfish, cobia, snapper when seas allow; deeper grouper. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, weedless spoons, popping cork. Sources: Fishin Franks Nov 13 (snook/reds/trout/sheepshead/pompano scattered across areas), FL Sportsman SW recent (redfish solid on live baits/oysters/mangroves).
redtide: FWC Nov 13 status: K. brevis background only in one Pinellas, one Sarasota, one offshore Collier sample past week in SWFL. Bloom concentrations in NW FL Bay/Gulf counties. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation near Englewood/Manasota. Next report Nov 20.
bacteria: Charlotte/Sarasota Healthy Beaches all Good. Englewood Beach / Manasota Key / Palm Island GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL recent samples Nov 2-3). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte/Sarasota minor isolated outages; no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
